'''M5-RT''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] at the time of the [[Galactic War]]. After the [[Conquest of Makeb]], it was sent to the [[Ilum Orbital Station (Imperial)|Imperial Orbital Station]] as a courier by [[Under-Moff]] [[Arribid Bensen|Bensen]] to help him enlist the services of the Imperial strike team regarding the containment and destruction of evidence of Imperial presence on the planet, [[Makeb]].
